scope: MOIS source-photograph interspecific photographic colour seasonality; NOT FCP within-species spatial W/D
required_matched_unit: same iNaturalist taxon x 0.25 degree cell x hemisphere-adjusted meteorological season-year; >=2 different observation IDs in >=2 seasons; real classified photo ROI colour
month_normals: WorldClim v2.1 1970–2000 climatic monthly normals, not the original observation year's weather
legacy_srad_v1_problem: WorldClim raw kJ m-2 day-1 mislabelled Wm2; all slope reports divide by 86.4

strict_three_plus_support_weak.caution: Insufficient for confirmatory seasonal climate response; multiple exploratory tests, low whole-taxon support

seasonal_naive_interpretation: Summer highest automated white-photo share in both extra-tropical hemispheres, but potential composition, geography, photographer and classifiability confounding
scientific_conclusion: No robust identified within-site-year white-photo response to climatological temperature, rain or solar from the pre-colour automatic ROI observations
caveats: Automatic photographic hue is not a botanist-confirmed OPEN FLOWER organ or genotype
Distinct observation IDs do not guarantee photographer independence
Historical measured atlas and 267425 extended ROI source are not independent provider studies
These are three separate univariate regressions with percentile bootstrap, NOT 24-family maxT
Soil, elevation and topography are stable site-level controls: within-site changes cannot identify static coefficients
Observed-month 2025 vs earlier weather, plant reproductive fitness and causality NOT measured
